Our Legal Services

Comprehensive Healthcare Defense

From clinic sealing to media defamation — we cover every legal threat facing Pakistan's healthcare professionals.

🏥

Clinic Sealing Cases

Immediate legal action to unseal your clinic. Emergency injunctions, regulatory challenges, and full compliance restoration within 24 hours of engagement.

⚖️

Medical Negligence Defense

Expert defense against negligence claims. We build comprehensive case strategies using medical evidence, expert witnesses, and established legal precedents.

🚨

FIR & Criminal Cases

Immediate bail applications, pre-arrest protection, and full criminal defense. We protect you at every stage of the criminal justice process.

📺

Media & Defamation Defense

False media allegations can destroy a career overnight. We issue legal notices, pursue defamation claims, and manage reputation crises with speed.

📋

PMDC / DRAP Regulatory Issues

License suspensions, registration disputes, drug authority penalties, and compliance challenges expertly navigated with deep regulatory knowledge.

📄

Legal Notices & Fines

Challenge unjust fines, respond to legal notices, and negotiate settlements that protect your practice without compromising your professional standing.

Founding CEO

Dr. Abid Khan
Advocate High Court

"Healthcare professionals dedicate their lives to saving others. When the system turns against them — whether through unjust clinic sealings, malicious FIRs, or media attacks — they deserve the strongest possible legal defense. That is what HRPP was built to provide."

Dr. Abid Khan is an Advocate of the High Court with specialized expertise at the intersection of medical practice and Pakistani law. Having witnessed firsthand the legal vulnerabilities faced by Pakistan's healthcare sector, he founded HRPP to create a dedicated legal shield for the profession.

With deep knowledge of PMDC regulations, DRAP compliance, and medical negligence jurisprudence, Dr. Khan has successfully defended over 500 healthcare professionals across Pakistan.

International Standards

EU Patients' Charter —
14 Fundamental Rights

Global healthcare rights standards that inform Pakistan's evolving medical law framework.

01
Right to Preventive Measures
02
Right of Access
03
Right to Information
04
Right to Consent
05
Right to Free Choice

Right to Privacy & Confidentiality

Right to Dignity
ECHR Article 2 (Right to Life) & Article 8 (Right to Private Life)
The European Convention on Human Rights establishes foundational protections that parallel Pakistan's own constitutional guarantees — including the right to dignity, privacy, and fair treatment in healthcare settings. HRPP applies these international standards to strengthen domestic legal arguments.
